description.value: The Rickshaw Theatre is a celebrated live music venue in Vancouver's Downtown Eastside, originally built in 1971 as the Shaw Theatre — part of the legendary Shaw Brothers' Hong Kong cinema empire. Reopened as a concert venue in 2009, it has won multiple 'Best Live Music Venue' awards from local outlets including the Georgia Straight (2018, 2019) and The Whammys (2016–2019). Touring cyclists can catch shows spanning punk, metal, hip hop, folk, and beyond, with full-service bars and a coat check on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is complete and corroborates all OSM contact fields (phone 604.681.8915, address 254 East Hastings Street Vancouver BC V6A 1P1, website URL). The FAQ explicitly states 'No food, but we do have full service bars' (food=false) and confirms a coat check exists (luggage/bag storage=true). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM name is 'The Rickshaw' but the venue consistently uses 'The Rickshaw Theatre' on its own website — the truncated OSM name may cause search confusion.
Venue is 19+ only for all shows unless otherwise noted, which may limit accessibility for some touring groups.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Rickshaw is an active, award-winning live music venue with a packed upcoming schedule; it meets the threshold for an Attractions listing as a destination a touring cyclist would visit for an evening show.
